title: Luke's theory: Old Kingdom pharaohs were never buried in their pyramids, but in the south near Abydos

tellings.quote: I think he knew something that's invisible to us today that the pharaohs of the old kingdom are never buried in their pyramids and their tombs are down south.

plain: The kings of Egypt's early Old Kingdom period were never buried in their pyramids at Giza; their real tombs lie in the south, near the ancient site of Abydos. That is the theory of a researcher who calls himself Luke Caverns, who gives no source but says a later pharaoh, Amenemhat III, seems to have known this. If right, it would mean the pyramids were built for some purpose other than tombs.
